What Do Tech Pioneers Think About the AI Revolution?

14 张卡片完整原句发音词汇延长 0.3s无 JS · 全端自适应
EXPR 01 Caroline Steele（主持）

at the cutting edge of

处于……的最前沿 / 尖端

We've brought together three engineers at the cutting edge of this field, to discuss their work and what it means for us humans.

我们请来了三位处于该领域最前沿的工程师，讨论他们的工作以及对人类意味着什么。

举一反三 · More Examples

  • This lab is at the cutting edge of battery research, producing cells twice as dense as commercial ones.
  • She built her career on the cutting edge of gene editing, and now leads a global consortium.
  • To stay at the cutting edge, engineers here publish every experiment openly and benchmark weekly.

重点词汇 · Key Words

cutting edge /ˈkʌtɪŋ edʒ/
n. 最前沿；领先地位
cutting edge 本义是「刀刃」，引申为行业/技术最前沿；常与 at / on 搭配，也可作形容词 cutting-edge（如 cutting-edge technology）。
field /fiːld/
n. 领域；田野
field 在本句指「研究领域」，in the field of AI = 在 AI 领域；注意与 plain（平原）区分。
EXPR 02 Regina Barzilai（MIT 教授）

be diagnosed with

被诊断患有（疾病）

And in 2014, I was diagnosed with breast cancer.

2014 年，我被诊断出患有乳腺癌。

举一反三 · More Examples

  • My uncle was diagnosed with diabetes during a routine check-up last spring.
  • The earlier a patient is diagnosed with cancer, the better the treatment outcomes tend to be.
  • She was diagnosed with a rare autoimmune disease, yet she kept teaching full-time.

重点词汇 · Key Words

diagnosed /ˈdaɪəɡnəʊzd/
v. 诊断（diagnose 的过去分词）
固定搭配 be diagnosed with + 疾病；名词 diagnosis /ˌdaɪəɡˈnəʊsɪs/；动词 diagnose。注意重音在 dia- 上。
oncology /ɒŋˈkɒlədʒi/
n. 肿瘤学
oncology 由 onco-（肿瘤）+ -logy（学科）构成；oncology 医生是 oncologist。不要与 cardiology（心脏病学）混淆。可听本句下方 Regina 回答中的 shift your work to oncology。
EXPR 03 Regina Barzilai

how come

为什么；怎么会（口语）

I'm thinking, how come we have all this great technology at MIT, but none of it is actually coming to the hospitals and helping patients?

我心想，为什么麻省理工有这么多厉害的技术，却没有一项真正走进医院、帮助病人呢？

举一反三 · More Examples

  • How come the lights are still on? I told everyone to leave by nine.
  • How come this app knows my location before I even open it?
  • How come nobody mentioned this bug in the meeting? It crashed twice this morning.

重点词汇 · Key Words

how come /ˈhaʊ kʌm/
口语短语：为什么
how come 后面直接跟陈述语序（how come you're late?），比 why 更口语、更带惊讶情绪；语序不像 why 那样倒装。
technology /tekˈnɒlədʒi/
n. 技术
泛指技术时常用单数不可数；具体技术用 technologies（复数）。科技公司常用 tech 简称。
EXPR 04 David Silver（DeepMind）

by trial and error

通过反复试验；摸索着来

From trial and error, from trying things out and seeing what works and what doesn't.

靠反复试验——不断尝试，看看什么有效、什么无效。

举一反三 · More Examples

  • We didn't have a manual for the machine, so we fixed it by trial and error.
  • Most cooking skills are learned by trial and error — nobody gets a perfect soufflé first try.
  • The startup's pricing model was refined by trial and error over two years.

重点词汇 · Key Words

trial /ˈtraɪəl/
n. 试验；审判
trial and error 是固定搭配（含 and，无冠词）；trial 也可表示临床试验 clinical trial。勿与 trail（小路 /ˈtreɪl/）混淆。
error /ˈerə(r)/
n. 错误；误差
比 mistake 更正式，常指系统性错误；a margin of error = 误差范围。trial-and-error 也可整体作形容词（a trial-and-error approach）。
EXPR 05 David Silver

at the end of the day

归根结底；说到底

And at the end of the day, everything comes from it — it stems from that one single number.

说到底，一切都来自它——来自那一个单一的数字。

举一反三 · More Examples

  • At the end of the day, what matters is whether the product solves a real problem.
  • We can argue about budgets all week, but at the end of the day, the deadline decides everything.
  • At the end of the day, users don't care about the tech stack — they care about speed and reliability.

重点词汇 · Key Words

stems from /stemz frɒm/
v. 源自，源于（stem from）
stem from 表示「根源在于」，主语通常是原因；与 come from / derive from 近义，但更强调逻辑因果。
single /ˈsɪŋɡl/
adj. 单一的；唯一的
one single number 强调「就这一个」；single 还作「单身的」。注意与 simple（简单的）区分。
EXPR 06 Caroline Steele

can relate to

能理解……；对……有共鸣

I'm sure much of our audience can relate to having an imaginary friend, but for most of us, they stay imaginary.

我相信在场很多听众都能对「拥有一个想象中的朋友」产生共鸣，但对大多数人来说，它只停留在想象中。

举一反三 · More Examples

  • Anyone who has worked a night shift can relate to the struggle of sleeping during the day.
  • I totally relate to her story about moving abroad alone at twenty.
  • These characters are so well written that every reader can relate to at least one of them.

重点词汇 · Key Words

relate /rɪˈleɪt/
v. 产生共鸣；相关；叙述
relate to sth = 理解/认同；relate to = 与……相关（be related to）。口语高频，relatable 是形容词「让人有共鸣的」。
imaginary /ɪˈmædʒɪnəri/
adj. 想象中的；虚构的
来自 imagine；勿与 imaginative（富有想象力的）混淆：imaginary friend 是想象中的朋友，imaginative writing 是有想象力的写作。
EXPR 07 Paolo Pirjanian（Embodied 创始人）

in need of

需要……的

Unfortunately, there are a lot of people in need of companionship or therapy, and there's a massive gap in the labor force that can provide this.

不幸的是，有大量的人需要陪伴或心理治疗，而能提供这些服务的劳动力存在巨大缺口。

举一反三 · More Examples

  • The old apartment block is badly in need of renovation after the flood.
  • Students in need of extra support can book a free session with the writing center.
  • Her car broke down in the desert, and the rescue team arrived just as she was in need of water.

重点词汇 · Key Words

companionship /kəmˈpænjənʃɪp/
n. 陪伴；伙伴关系
由 companion（同伴）+ -ship（抽象名词后缀）构成；companion 比 friend 更中性，指同行者/伴侣。
therapy /ˈθerəpi/
n. 治疗；疗法
therapy 侧重「疗程/疗法」，如 physical therapy、speech therapy；therapist 是治疗师。与 treatment（治疗过程）近义。
EXPR 08 David Silver

be devoted to

致力于；专门用于

So in fact, humans are believed to have a major part of the brain which is devoted to providing a signal, giving feedback.

事实上，人类大脑有很大一部分被认为专门用于提供信号、给出反馈。

举一反三 · More Examples

  • This research center is devoted entirely to understanding how the brain learns.
  • She devoted two decades of her life to improving rural education.
  • A huge slice of the company's budget is devoted to customer feedback systems.

重点词汇 · Key Words

devoted /dɪˈvəʊtɪd/
adj./v. 献身的；投入的（devote 的过去分词）
be devoted to + 名词/动名词，to 是介词；devote oneself to = 献身于；devoted 也可形容人「忠诚的」。
feedback /ˈfiːdbæk/
n. 反馈
不可数名词，a lot of feedback；作动词常用 give / provide feedback。注意拼写 feed + back。
EXPR 09 Paolo Pirjanian

have a hard time (doing)

做某事很困难 / 费劲

So this is not too dissimilar from a child on the autism spectrum that has a hard time expressing themselves.

这与自闭症谱系中的孩子并无太大不同——他们往往很难表达自己。

举一反三 · More Examples

  • I always have a hard time remembering people's names at conferences.
  • New drivers often have a hard time judging distances when parking.
  • She had a hard time saying no to her colleagues, even when her plate was full.

重点词汇 · Key Words

dissimilar /dɪˈsɪmɪlə(r)/
adj. 不同的
dis-（否定）+ similar；not too dissimilar from = 与……大同小异，双否定表强调。书面感比 different 更强。
autism spectrum /ˈɔːtɪzəm ˈspektrəm/
n. 自闭症谱系
autism（自闭症）+ spectrum（光谱/范围）；on the autism spectrum 是常见搭配；spectrum 也常用于政治光谱。
EXPR 10 Caroline Steele

go about doing

着手做；处理（某事）

How did you go about making a real one?

你是怎么着手做出一个「真的」来的呢？

举一反三 · More Examples

  • So how would you go about convincing your manager to approve the budget?
  • We went about solving the problem the wrong way and lost a whole day.
  • Instead of complaining, she went about improving the workflow quietly and efficiently.

重点词汇 · Key Words

go about /ɡəʊ əˈbaʊt/
v. 着手做；忙于
go about + doing/n. = 着手处理；go about your day = 过你的日子。口语中高频，类似 get down to / set about。
imaginary /ɪˈmædʒɪnəri/
adj. 想象中的
此处呼应上文 imaginary friend；与 realistic（真实的）相对。记忆：image（图像）→ imagine（想象）→ imaginary（想象中的）。
EXPR 11 David Silver

one size fits all

一刀切；万能解决方案

One thing I would say is, I think it's hard sometimes to come up with a one-size-fits-all recipe for AI, because it's so different in different areas.

我想说的是，有时候很难为 AI 想出一套「一刀切」的万能方案，因为不同领域差异太大了。

举一反三 · More Examples

  • There's no one-size-fits-all diet — everyone's body responds differently.
  • A one-size-fits-all policy rarely works for schools in both big cities and small villages.
  • The CEO warned that the new safety rule was a one-size-fits-all solution that ignored local conditions.

重点词汇 · Key Words

recipe /ˈresɪpi/
n. 配方；诀窍；菜谱
本句中是比喻用法，指「方法/配方」；a recipe for disaster = 灾难的温床。注意读音 /ˈresɪpi/，结尾是 -pi。
regulation /ˌreɡjuˈleɪʃn/
n. 法规；监管
regulate（v. 管控）+ -tion；AI regulation 是热点话题。复数 regulations 常指具体条文。
EXPR 12 Paolo Pirjanian

an arms race

军备竞赛（此处借指技术竞赛）

So it's a bit of an arms race, and I think for that reason, practically speaking, it's going to be very hard to regulate it to that level.

所以这有点像一场军备竞赛，正因如此，实际上很难把监管做到那个程度。

举一反三 · More Examples

  • The rivalry between the two tech giants has turned into an AI arms race.
  • Historians compare the current chip competition to a modern arms race.
  • A global arms race in drones would only make the region more unstable.

重点词汇 · Key Words

arms race /ɑːmz reɪs/
n. 军备竞赛
arms（武器）+ race（竞赛）；引申为各国/企业在技术上的激烈竞赛（an AI arms race）。
regulate /ˈreɡjuleɪt/
v. 管控；调节
regulate 侧重「用规则约束」；名词 regulation。regulate 还可表「调节温度/音量」。
EXPR 13 Caroline Steele

be out of time

时间用完了；没时间了

I wish we could take more, but I'm afraid we're out of time.

我真希望还能多回答几个问题，但恐怕时间已经不够了。

举一反三 · More Examples

  • We're out of time for questions, but the speakers will stay for twenty minutes.
  • The team was out of time and out of options, so they shipped the beta anyway.
  • I'm afraid we're out of time — let's continue this discussion tomorrow.

重点词汇 · Key Words

out of time /aʊt əv taɪm/
短语：时间耗尽
out of + 资源 = 用完（out of money / out of patience）；对比 run out of time（时间用完，动词短语）。
afraid /əˈfreɪd/
adj. 恐怕；害怕的
I'm afraid 是委婉表达，表遗憾/抱歉，不是真的「害怕」；afraid of + 名词，afraid to do + 动词。
EXPR 14 Caroline Steele

it's fair to say

可以公允地说；说句公道话

I think it's fair to say all three of you have given us hope for the future.

我认为可以公允地说，你们三位都让我们对未来充满希望。

举一反三 · More Examples

  • I think it's fair to say the project exceeded everyone's expectations.
  • It's fair to say that remote work has permanently changed how teams collaborate.
  • Given the results, it's fair to say our bet on this technology paid off.

重点词汇 · Key Words

fair /feə(r)/
adj. 公平的；合理的
it's fair to say = 这么说很公允；fair 还表「晴朗的；中等的」。对比 fare（票价 /feə(r)/）同音。
prolific /prəˈlɪfɪk/
adj. 多产的；成果丰硕的
常形容作家/科学家作品多（a prolific author）；音频后半段 Regina 用它形容爱因斯坦（as prolific as they were）。
